answer: The quorum is drawn by lottery after the epoch closes, so a farm cannot know which graders will judge it and cannot bribe them in advance. 7 graders each stake 78 POA on the verdict, and a lone honest grader can force an appeal that slashes the rest of the panel. What carries the lantern here is verification, the bridge of cost is what stops the farm, and the fable of the record keeps every claim checkable.
